summary.en: One step straight, then one diagonally — unless its leg is blocked.
summary.zh: 先直走一步，再斜走一步——马腿被绊住就不行。

text.en: The horse moves one point straight and then one point diagonally outward (a 日 shape). From the middle it has eight moves.
text.zh: 马先直走一步，再向外斜走一步，走“日”字。在中间时有八个去处。

text.en: If a piece stands right next to the horse, it blocks the horse's leg (蹩马腿). The soldier on e5 stops the jumps to d6 and f6.
text.zh: 如果马旁边紧挨着有棋子，就绊住了马腿（蹩马腿）。e5的兵挡住了去d6和f6的路。

text.en: Hop your horse to collect the stars.
Find a horse move that attacks the chariot and the cannon at the same time.
text.zh: 找一步马，同时攻击黑车和黑炮。

hint.en: Look at the point between them, in front of your horse.
hint.zh: 看看马前面、它们俩中间的位置。

wrong.en: That attacks only one piece, or none.
wrong.zh: 这步只攻击了一个子，或者都没攻击到。

success.en: A fork! Black can only save one of them.

text.en: A piece stands right next to the horse in the direction it wants to go. Can it jump that way?
text.zh: 马要走的方向上紧挨着有一个棋子，马能跳过去吗？

explanation.en: Unlike the chess knight, the Xiangqi horse can be blocked.
explanation.zh: 和国际象棋的马不同，象棋的马会被绊腿。
